# BenchDump

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Prints the kernel's benchmark counters to the kernel console (CONFIG_ZUZU_BENCH builds only; a no-op otherwise).

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
void BenchDump(void);
```
